cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 560: 30 displayed points from 56 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 460–560: all 11 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 683.254, interval [619.536, 751.901]. Paired change versus generation 550: -10.573, 95% interval [-78.951, 42.466]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 7,168 games; 56 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 201.268.
